page.layout: One blank leaf. Only show-through from the other side at the top and a pencilled or inked drawing in the centre.
page.notes: Show-through: mirrored printed text at the top of the leaf, from the reverse side. Not transcribed. Drawing in the centre (a looping, ornament-like sketch in grey-blue ink or pencil): handwriting or doodle, not printed, not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature visible. Blank otherwise.
